ruleDefinitions.name: Change Winevt Channel Access Permission Via Registry
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects tampering with the "ChannelAccess" registry key in order to change access to Windows event channel. Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\WINEVT\\\\Channels\\\\.*") AND registry_path = RGX("\\\\ChannelAccess$") AND (Details = RGX(".*\\(A\\;\\;0x1\\;\\;\\;LA\\).*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\(A\\;\\;0x1\\;\\;\\;SY\\).*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\(A\\;\\;0x5\\;\\;\\;BA\\).*"))) AND  NOT (process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\servicing\\TrustedInstaller\.exe" OR (process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\WinSxS\\\\") AND process_path = RGX("\\\\TiWorker\\\.exe$")))
